title: 第1369章 冰元大怒第1368章 不死之体
content_zh:
“我能继承？”
林炎微愣。
“不错！任何九大神体，都可以直接吸收同血脉类型的所有体质之力！”
“比如圣族的圣神体，可以吸收圣族五大体质的圣耀道体，纯阳圣天体等。而妖族的妖神体，也可吸收万妖体，雷象体等。”
“冥神体，也是一样的，可以吸收各种冥界体质。长生体、不死之体，都可以吸收。”
苍天道火身为九大神火，对九大神体这种神物是最了解的，对神体的了解，就连暗天矛也都远远无法相提并论。
“哦？还有这个说法？不过我这冥神体吸收了不死之体的话，貌似也没什么用吧？我的冥神体已经是神体了，吸收一个更次一等的血脉，岂不是会血脉驳杂？”
林炎沉吟。
“当然不是，你吸收其他的冥界体质血脉，可以获得对应的血脉的力量。比如不死之体，可以获得不死特性。”
“也就只有神体才能有这样的效果，换做其他体质，比如长生体，就没法这样吸收融合不死之体，会爆的！”
苍天道火道。
林炎眼睛一亮：“那我来试试！”
“九龙吞天诀！”
功法运转，不死之体的精髓便被吸走，林炎感觉自己体内的血液一瞬间变得十分滚烫，就好像血液沸腾了一半。
“好难受！啊啊啊！”
那种感觉十分痛苦，好似有无数只虫子在血液之中，让林炎忍不住想要将自己全身的血液之力给抽干。
“林炎你没事吧！”
这可把一旁的上官月吓了一跳，忍不住就要上前。
“这家伙在炼化不死之体的力量呢，这是正常反应。”
苍天道火道。

毕竟是三大冥界之体，不可能随便就能炼化。
到了这个层次，就是炼化一颗丹药，那也都是很费劲的！
在林炎炼化不死之体的时候，冥玄圣主洞府外，又有几支队伍降临了。
这几支队伍，大部分都是洪河星域的那些圣地级势力。
甚至还有顶级势力。
比如五大宗门之一的焚天宗，还有三大殿之一的圣殿。
其中焚天宗领头的是一位太长老级别的人物，名叫俞陀，在洪河星域内也是赫赫有名的一号人物，实力极为不简单，乃是圣君四重。
而圣殿这边，领头的则是之前跟林炎有过过节的冰元长老。
冰元看到王波等人居然杵在洞府外，不敢踏入其中，便是冷声道：
“海神圣地的圣子，你们为何不入洞府？还有海神圣主道友呢？”
“是冰元前辈！”
王波顿时惊喜。
“前辈，还请替我们海神圣地出头！我家圣主被林炎那小畜生给坑死了！”
王波将之前发生在此地的事情添油加醋的跟冰元说了一遍。
原本海神圣主是死在守护兽手里，而王波则是将这一切归咎于林炎，说是林炎故意设局坑死了海神圣主。
不过冰元是懒得管这些乱七八糟的事情的。
只是，当冰元得知林炎居然进入到了冥玄圣主的洞府之中，顿时眼中闪过一丝惊色：“该死，你们怎么能让那小畜生进去了！”
“我们也很想拦住那小畜生，奈何实力不够啊！”
海神圣地众人苦笑。
“冰元道友，难不成这洞府里面有猫腻？”

焚天宗的太长老看向冰元。
冰元脸色变幻，而后冷冷道：“没什么，就是这冥玄圣地的圣主洞府里面可能有一些逆天的机缘罢了！”
“冰元前辈，那小子进去之后到现在还没出来，估计还在里面寻宝呢，现在杀进去还来得及！那小畜生肯定没来得及跑路！”
海天圣君抱拳道。
content_en:
"Can I inherit?"
Lin Yan was slightly stunned.
"That's right! Any of the nine divine bodies can directly absorb the power of all physiques of the same blood type!"
"For example, the Saint Clan's Holy God Body can absorb the Saint Clan's five major physical bodies, the Holy Glory Dao Body, the Pure Yang Saint Celestial Body, etc. The Demon Clan's Demon God Body can also absorb the Ten Thousand Demon Body, the Thunder Elephant Body, etc."
"The Hades body is the same. It can absorb various underworld physiques. Immortal bodies and immortal bodies can both be absorbed."
Cangtian Daohuo, as one of the Nine Divine Fires, knows the most about divine objects like the Nine Divine Bodies. His understanding of divine bodies is far beyond even the Dark Sky Spear.
"Oh? Is there any other explanation? But if my Hades body absorbs the immortal body, it seems to be of no use, right? My Hades body is already a divine body. If I absorb a lower-level bloodline, wouldn't it cause mixed blood?"
Lin Yan pondered.
"Of course not. If you absorb the blood of other underworld physiques, you can obtain the power of the corresponding blood. For example, if you have an immortal body, you can obtain the characteristics of immortality."
"Only the divine body can have such an effect. If you use other bodies, such as the immortal body, you cannot absorb and fuse the immortal body like this, and it will explode!"
The way of heaven is the way of fire.
Lin Yan's eyes lit up: "Then let me give it a try!"
"Nine Dragons Devouring Heaven Technique!"
As the technique was running, the essence of the immortal body was sucked away. Lin Yan felt that the blood in his body became very hot in an instant, as if the blood was half boiling.
"It feels so uncomfortable! Ahhh!"
The feeling was very painful, as if there were countless bugs in the blood, and Lin Yan couldn't help but want to drain all the blood from his body.
"Lin Yan, are you okay?"
This startled Shangguan Yue on the side, and she couldn't help but step forward.
"This guy is refining the power of his immortal body. This is a normal reaction."
The way of heaven is the way of fire.
After all, it is the body of the three underworlds and cannot be refined casually.
At this level, even refining a pill is very laborious!
While Lin Yan was refining his immortal body, several more teams arrived outside the cave of Lord Mingxuan.
Most of these teams are those Holy Land-level forces in the Honghe Star Region.
There are even top forces.
For example, the Burning Heaven Sect, one of the five major sects, and the Holy Temple, one of the three major halls.
Among them, the leader of the Burning Sky Sect is a Tai Elder-level figure named Yu Tuo. He is also a famous figure in the Honghe Star Territory. His strength is extremely extraordinary, and he is the fourth level of the Saint King.
As for the temple, the leader was Elder Bing Yuan, who had had issues with Lin Yan before.
When Bing Yuan saw Wang Bo and others standing outside the cave, not daring to step inside, he said coldly:
"Holy sons of the Holy Land of the Sea, why don't you enter the cave? And where are the fellow Taoist Masters of the Holy Land of the Sea?"
"It's Senior Bingyuan!"
Wang Bo was suddenly pleasantly surprised.
"Senior, please stand up for our Holy Land of the Sea! My Holy Master was tricked to death by that little beast Lin Yan!"
Wang Bo told Bing Yuan about what happened here before in an exaggerated manner.
It turned out that the Lord of the Sea died at the hands of the guardian beast, but Wang Bo blamed all this on Lin Yan, saying that Lin Yan deliberately set up a trap to kill the Lord of the Sea.
But Bing Yuan is too lazy to care about these messy things.
However, when Bingyuan learned that Lin Yan had actually entered the cave of Holy Master Mingxuan, a look of surprise suddenly flashed in his eyes: "Damn it, how could you let that little beast in!"
"We also want to stop that little beast, but we don't have enough strength!"
Everyone in Poseidon Holy Land smiled bitterly.
"Fellow Taoist Bingyuan, is there something fishy in this cave?"
The Grand Elder of Burning Heaven Sect looked at Bing Yuan.
Bing Yuan's face changed, and then he said coldly: "It's nothing, it's just that there may be some heaven-defying opportunities in the Holy Lord's Cave of Mingxuan Holy Land!"
"Senior Bingyuan, that kid hasn't come out since he went in. He's probably still looking inside.As for Bao, it's still too late to get in now! That little beast definitely didn't have time to escape! "
Saint Lord Haitian cupped his fists.
